name: specloop
description: Spec-driven loop engineering for agents: numbered phase specs, an enforced structure, a mandatory Spec Summary/Status handoff, and the loop that drives them.

interface.shortDescription: Drive agents through numbered phase specs with enforced structure and mandatory status handoffs.
interface.longDescription: specloop is a repeatable construct for spec-driven agent work: decompose a goal into numbered phase files (each a flat checklist of atomic tasks), run an agent loop that executes the next unchecked box and verifies it, and hand off in a mandatory Spec Summary/Status format. A bun validator enforces the directory structure so it never silently drifts, and a goal-completion-check prompt audits whether a goal is truly met by tracing it through requirements → specs → checkboxes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up specloop in this repository and decompose my goal into phase specs.
